vendors.name: Restimo
vendors.reason: Polish ordering platform with € prices ('ORDERING' €39/month per store; 'All prices are net (excluding VAT).', pricing for clients outside Poland) and a contact-form country dropdown that includes Estonia; but neither its pricing page nor its ordering page mentions pickup, takeaway or ordering ahead ('5 Countries', no country named in a sentence). Fails the order-ahead rule.

vendors.name: Telli Toit
vendors.reason: Estonian consumer food-ordering app (pre-order and pick up yourself; courier delivery stopped 20.06.2022 per its App Store listing) - a shared consumer app across venues, no business price or own site found. Not opened.

vendors.reason: TalTech student project: table-QR ordering only. Not opened.
